description: FateCat control-plane resource contract. It defines the shared spec/status/admission/drift envelope for infrastructure resources without storing runtime proof payloads.
invariants: ControlPlane resources are discovery and reconciliation envelopes; they must not duplicate full source registries.
Capability default admission must keep planned capabilities discoverable but non-executable.
Provider reconciliation must point at provider lifecycle gate instead of reimplementing source/license/vendor checks.
ReleaseGate control-plane status may be available while live shipGate remains blocked by external connectivity.
EvaluationRun resources must remain evaluation-only and must not inject benchmark answers into production providers.
ControlPlane registry must not store token, secret, DSN, production log, report body, user birth data, container registry token, or webhook secret.
A control-plane gate pass proves registry/spec/status alignment only; it does not prove production API, HF Space, Bot, OIDC, SIEM, OTel, Vault, KMS, or live rollback completion.
